title: In the news
description: Understand news headlines and discuss current events.

introduction.headline: Read and discuss the news
introduction.body: You will learn vocabulary for news stories and practise summarising and reacting to headlines.
introduction.bodyIt: Imparerai vocabolario per le notizie e praticherai riassunti e reazioni ai titoli.
objectives: Express your reaction to a story

vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Il titolo ha attirato la mia attenzione.

vocabulary.example: There is a debate about climate policy.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: C'è un dibattito sulla politica climatica.

vocabulary.example: According to the report, sales have risen.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Secondo il report, le vendite sono aumentate.

options: The main title of a news story
exercises.answer: The main title of a news story
exercises.explanation: A headline is the title at the top of a news article.

exercises.prompt: According to the ____, the economy is growing.
exercises.promptIt: Completa: According to the ____, the economy is growing.
exercises.explanation: According to the report is a common news phrase.

review.tip: Read one English headline today and explain it in one sentence.
